dumps the records of a log namespace

Usage: dolos data dump logs [OPTIONS] --namespace <NAMESPACE>

Options:
      --namespace <NAMESPACE>
          namespace to dump

      --from-epoch <EPOCH>
          the first epoch whose logs to dump

      --to-epoch <EPOCH>
          the last epoch whose logs to dump

      --limit <N>
          Print at most this many records; 0 prints every one
          
          [default: 100]

      --offset <N>
          Skip this many records first
          
          [default: 0]

      --format <FORMAT>
          How to print the result: text for people, JSON for scripts
          
          [default: text]
          [possible values: text, json]

      --layout <LAYOUT>
          How text output lays out its rows
          
          [default: table]

          Possible values:
          - table:  a table
          - dbsync: comma-separated rows under cardano-db-sync's column names

  -c, --config <CONFIG>
          

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
